headline: Mooring County Extends Warden Grip; Stlican Tilts
war_summary: Latest returns show two boards altered since the morning edition. Mooring County now stands eleven Warden posts against one Colonial, its 24-hour notices still centered on Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Cut. Stlican Shelf has shifted to four Warden posts and five Colonial after fresh action at Fort Hoarfrost. Weathered Expanse remains six-to-three in Warden favor and is again the most heavily worked map, with Crow's Nest, Frostmarch, and Wightwalk taking repeated ownership notices while casualties climb on both sides. Stonecradle is unchanged at one Warden post to eight Colonial, but casualty totals are heavy and no strategic marker has moved since the morning cutoff. Farranac Coast repeats one Warden post to ten Colonial with steep losses on both sides; Callahans Passage is wholly Warden-held with no change on the board but a heavy casualty sheet. Fishermans Row, Linn Mercy, and Gutter remain quiet. No winner has been declared.
